title: runtime: the legacy /automation/trigger POST past three segments is bounded like the /actions arity rule
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPF1skfu2kx89BEXZi

Filing gate: ④ follow-up node of G1 #31691 part (c) (PR #32001). The thread's open question on the PR was ruled "leave as on base, file a follow-up card" (contract review 6754801375, open questions; seat delta record 6755708575).
Business reason: the legacy run door `POST /api/v1/automation/trigger/...` still accepts a path deeper than any shape it serves. On a catch-all host (`createHonoApp`), a call of four or more segments runs a flow and ignores the tail. That is the same loose-parse class that part (b) bounded for `/actions` (#31979) and that part (c) bounded at three segments for this door.
Reader: the `domain:server` seat that owns `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`, after PR #32001 merges (same file).
Dedupe: no open or closed card names the legacy trigger's arity past three segments.
class: c · type: Tech debt

## 维护者速读

- 问题：旧的 `POST /automation/trigger/...` 收到超过三段的路径时，catch-all 宿主仍会跑一个 flow，并把多余的段忽略掉。
- 要做：和 `/actions`（#31979）一样给它设上限：超过服务形状的深度一律拒绝，不跑任何东西。
- 需要你做的：无，车道派发。

## What to build

1. Bound the legacy trigger arm in `handleAutomationRequest`. A bare `trigger/:name` (two segments) and an addressed `trigger/:ns/:name` (three segments) are served. Any deeper `POST` is declined as an unserved shape before any gate runs anything. Answer as part (b) does for `/actions`: on a mounted host the dispatcher's `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`; on a catch-all host the host's own `404`.
2. Other verbs at those depths belong to a flow named `trigger` (for example `GET /automation/trigger/runs/:runId`). They are untouched. Pin that as a CONTROL.
3. Pins:
   - a bare call past the bound runs nothing;
   - an addressed call past the bound runs nothing;
   - the served two- and three-segment calls still run (CONTROL).

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: a path that ran a flow is declined. Measure the first-party count; none is expected, because no first-party client sends the legacy door past two segments. `Metadata-protocol: none`, a runtime `patch` changeset with a BREAKING block.

Precondition: PR #32001 merged.
